title: DMU too loud at 80 km/h
why: The DMU row: 72 dB stationary is allowed, 82 dB pass-by is not.

noise.stationary_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.1 Table 2 (LpAeq,T[unit]: electric locomotives 70, diesel locomotives 71, EMUs 65, DMUs 72, coaches 64, wagons 65 dB): DMU row, 72 ≤ 72.

noise.pass_by_80_db.rationale: Noise TSI 4.2.3 Table 4 (80 km/h: electric locomotives 84, diesel 85, EMUs 80, DMUs 81, coaches 79, wagons 83 dB; 250 km/h, if applicable: electric locomotives 99, EMUs 95, DMUs 96 dB): DMU row, 82 > 81.
